arxiv-2403-02801.title: On Cepheid Distances in the H 0 H_{0} measurement
arxiv-2403-02801.creator: Richard I. Anderson
arxiv-2403-02801.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Richard I. Anderson. Classical Cepheids were the first stellar standard candles and have played a crucial role for astronomical distance measurements ever since the discovery of the Leavitt law (period-luminosity relation). Enormous improvements in distance accuracy have been achieved since Hertzsprung’s first application of Leavitt’s law to measure the distance to the Small Magellanic Cloud in 1913, notably in very recent years thanks to a large data set of highly accurate space astrometry from the ESA mission Gaia .

arxiv-2509-26552.title: The REDTOP experiment: a η / η ′ \eta/\eta^{\prime} factory to explore dark matter and physics beyond the Standard Model Thanks: Presented at Workshop at 1 GeV scale: From meson to axions, Kraków (Poland), September 19-20, 2024

arxiv-2509-26552.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marcin Zieliński Corrado Gatto for the REDTOP Collaboaration. The REDTOP experiment is a proposed super- η \eta / η ′ \eta^{\prime} factory aimed at exploring physics beyond the Standard Model in the MeV-GeV range and rare η \eta / η ′ \eta^{\prime} meson decays. With projected production rates exceeding 10 13 10^{13} η \eta /year and 10 12 10^{12} η ′ \eta^{\prime} /year, REDTOP will enable studies of symmetry violations and all four portals to the Dark Sector.

arxiv-2512-17145.creator: Josh Barber Queensland University of Technology (QUT) Brisbane, Australia josh.barber@connect.qut.edu.au Rourke Young Queensland University of Technology (QUT) Brisbane, Australia rourke.young@connect.qut.edu.au Cameron Coombe Queensland University of Technology (QUT), CSIRO Brisbane, Australia came
arxiv-2512-17145.description: Abstract Reasoning under uncertainty is a key challenge in AI, especially for real-world tasks, where problems with sparse data demands systematic generalisation. Existing approaches struggle to balance accuracy and simplicity when evaluating multiple candidate solutions. We propose a Solomonoff-inspired method that weights LLM-generated hypotheses by simplicity and predictive fit.

pmc-12560511.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPhysical capacity (PC) defines the limits for physical activity (PA), while activities in daily life typically remain submaximal. Older adults whose daily activities approach their physical capacity may experience less functional decline, though prospective evidence is limited.
